count_weights_all: count all learnable parameters in the current default TensorFlow graph
count_weights_scope: count learnable parameters restricted to a specific variable scope in the TensorFlow graph
count_weights_exclude: count learnable parameters excluding variables matching a regex pattern from the TensorFlow graph
count_weights_custom_graph: count learnable parameters in a custom TensorFlow graph instead of the default graph
count_weights_scope_and_exclude: count learnable parameters in a variable scope while excluding variables matching a regex pattern
